conclusion: Whole-callback tracing rejects every field written by either a renderer or other callback code. Fields not written in this matrix remain only candidates: persistent initialization, other events and other operating modes still require tracing.
next_target: Trace initialization and non-note event paths for read-but-never-callback-written fields before attempting an inert canary.
safety: Stock firmware execution and synthetic renderer-state selection only; no firmware was modified.
